title: Backups
page_description: Create manual backups, import a backup archive, and review automatic backup history.
import_hint: Upload a backup ZIP created by this system (database.sql + public storage). This will overwrite the current database and restore stored files.
upload_too_large: The uploaded file exceeds the server's maximum allowed upload size.
import_failed: Failed to import and restore backup.
confirm_import: This will overwrite the current database and restore storage files from the uploaded backup. Continue?
confirm_restore: This will overwrite the current database and restore storage files from this backup. Continue?
empty: No backups yet. Create one manually, import a backup ZIP, or enable automatic backups.
